mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO market_universe_snapshot (business_date, universe_scope, source, content_hash, members_json, evidence_json, observed_at) VALUES(#{businessDate}, #{universeScope}, #{source}, #{contentHash}, #{membersJson}, #{evidenceJson}, #{observedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, business_date, universe_scope, source, content_hash, observed_at FROM market_universe_snapshot WHERE business_date=#{date} AND universe_scope='BSE_A' AND source='SINA' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
